question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: Showing deep respect.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Reverent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Reverent"** means showing deep respect and admiration for someone or something. (गंभीर सम्मान)
 
 
• **Example:** The audience was silent and reverent during the teacher's farewell speech.
 
 
• In this context, "Reverent" is the best one-word substitute for "showing deep respect."
 
• The Hindi meaning of "Reverent" is "श्रद्धालु" or "सम्मानजनक."
